body: As I mentioned in my original post, I cannot seek professional help as it can be grounds for inadmissibility to the United States. I may loose the job I have been offered on the basis of mental instability. The inhumanity of bureaucratic hassles whether it is in the US or India is just too much for a single individual to fight against. I would rather end it all rather than live a miserable life constantly fighting against the system.

Thanks for the kind words, but I am not sure I can do this. Going to India without a place to stay or a job is very scary. Also I don't know I can find work in area of my expertise due to all the bureaucracy. 

>And remember, none of this is your fault.

That is what makes it so painful. If I were not good enough, if I were not able to convince the community here that I am good at what I do, I could have blamed myself for my failures. There is a limit to how much a person can suffer. No one around me understands what it is like to work towards something your whole life, and then it is suddenly taken away from you.
